name: stripecard2
title: Image Reveal Card
description: A square photo card overlaid with a green gradient where a long white headline sits over the lower half and a Read Story link slides into view on hover.
use: A blog or landing page wants a big image to carry a headline with a quiet reveal.
avoid: Touch screens cannot hover, so the Read Story link never appears and the headline is clipped at rest.
a11y: The link stays invisible when focused from the keyboard, and the alt text 'shoes' does not describe the mountain photo. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A square card holding a photo of green alpine mountains under a cloudy sky. The lower third dissolves into a vivid green gradient, over which white text carries a four-line headline, with a small 'Read Story' link near the bottom.
behaves: On hover the photo eases from slightly zoomed to full size while the text block slides up from below the edge, bringing the Read Story link into view; on leave it settles back down.
customise: The headline, link and image URL are hardcoded, and the green gradient colours and 400px square size need editing in the file. No props.
weight: light: One image and a few CSS transitions; idle at rest.
demo: Headline about going to the mountains changing your thoughts and lifestyle, link 'Read Story'.
issues: Alt text says 'shoes' but the photo shows mountains.
The Read Story link is hidden until hover and invisible to keyboard focus.
polishWhy: Strong image and clear hover reveal; the heavy green overlay weakens text contrast near the bottom.
